servidas: servir — served, waited on (past part. fem. pl.; de quien son servidas 'by whom they are served'; = servidas)
menguadas: menguar — lacking, wanting, diminished (past part. fem. pl.; non serán menguadas 'they shall never be in want'; = menguadas, closest faltas)
casáredes: casar — (when) you shall marry (someone) off, give in marriage (future subjunctive 2nd pl., old -des ending; quando vos nos casáredes 'when you give us in marriage'; = casareis)
levanté: levantar — I raised, brought about, started (preterite 1st sg.; non lo levanté yo 'I did not bring it about', Pidal 'no lo inicié, no lo hice'; = levanté)
pedidas: pedir — asked for (past part. fem. pl. agreeing with the object vos; pedidas vos ha 'he has asked for you'; = pedidas)
rogadas: rogar — requested, entreated (past part. fem. pl., agreeing with vos; pedidas vos ha e rogadas 'he has asked and begged for you'; = rogadas)
atan: atan — so (a- + tan; atan firme mientre 'so firmly'; = tan)
cosa: cosa — thing; nulla cosa 'anything' (after a negative, 'nothing'; = cosa)
sope: saber — I knew (how to), could (strong preterite 1st sg.; nulla cosa nol sope dezir de no 'I could say no to him in nothing', i.e. I could not refuse; = supe)
metivos: meter + vos — I put you (preterite 1st sg. metí + enclitic vos; Metivos en sus manos 'I put you in his hands'; = os metí)
ados: a + dos — a dos, two together (amas ados 'both together', 'the two of you'; = ambas a dos; the a and dos run together)
creades: creer — (that) you believe (present subjunctive 2nd pl., old -ades ending, here a polite command; bien me lo creades 'believe me well'; = creáis)
suelo: suelo — floor, ground (Latin solum; por el suelo 'on the floor'; = suelo)
encortinado: encortinado — hung with hangings (past part. of encortinar, masc. sg.; por el suelo e suso tan bien encortinado 'so well hung with hangings on the floor and above', Pidal 'cubierto de tapices por el suelo y por las paredes'; = entapizado)
pórpola: pórpola — purple cloth, a costly dyed fabric (fem. noun, Latin purpura; tanta pórpola 'so much purple'; = púrpura)
xámed: xámed — samite, a rich silk cloth (masc. noun; tanto xámed 'so much samite', Pidal 'tela de seda'; = jamete)
paño: paño — cloth, fabric; paño preciado 'costly cloth' (= paño)
preciado: preçiado — valuable, costly (adj. masc. sg., from preçiar; here spelt without the cedilla; paño preciado 'costly cloth'; = preciado)
abriedes: aver — you would have (conditional 2nd pl., the infinitive aver + the imperfect ending -iedes, Latin habere + habebatis; sabor abriedes 'you would have pleasure'; = habríais)
seer: seer — to sit (infinitive, Latin sedere; sabor … de seer e de comer 'pleasure in sitting and eating'); also the infinitive of ser 'to be' (= sentarse, estar sentado; ser)
adeliñavan: adeliñar — they made straight for, headed to (imperfect 3rd pl.; adeliñavan al palaçio 'they made for the hall'; = adeliñaban, closest se dirigían)
quedos: quedo — quiet, calm, still (adj. masc. pl., used adverbially; qué quedos entraron! 'how quietly they entered!'; = quedos, closest callados, mansos)
reçibiólos: recebir + los — he received them (preterite 3rd sg. reçibió + enclitic los; = los recibió)
ssu: su — his, her (spelling with doubled s after a; a ssu mugier 'to his wife'; = su)
omillaron: omillar — they bowed, did homage (preterite 3rd pl., used with reflexive se; se le omillaron 'they bowed low to him'; = se humillaron, closest se inclinaron)
preçioso: preçioso — precious, costly (masc. sg.; un preçioso escaño 'a costly bench'; = precioso)
escaño: escaño — bench, long seat with a back (masc. sg.; = escaño)
acordados: acordado — prudent, well-schooled, of sound judgment (Pidal 'prudente', of v. 2217: tan bien son acordados 'they are so well-schooled') · also agreed, of one mind (past part. masc. pl. of acordar; assí son acordados 'they are so agreed'; = acordados)
mientes: mientes — mind, attention (fem. pl., Latin mentes; parar mientes 'to pay heed, consider'; están parando mientes al … 'they are watching the …'; = mientes, closest atención)
levantado: levantar — risen, raised (past part. masc. sg. with es; es levantado 'has risen, is on his feet'; = levantado)
imos: ir — we go (present 1st pl.; lo imos tardando 'we are delaying it'; ir + gerund 'keep on'; = vamos)
tardando: tardar — delaying (gerund; lo imos tardando 'we are putting it off'; = tardando, closest demorando)
amo: amar — I love (present 1st sg.; el que yo quiero e amo 'he whom I want and love'; = amo)
affé: affé — behold, here is/are (presentative; affé amas mis fijas 'behold both my daughters'; cf. afé; origin uncertain; = he aquí)
métolas: meter + las — I put them (present 1st sg. meto + enclitic las, the stress written; métolas en vuestra mano 'I put them in your hand'; = las meto)
sabedes: saber — you know (present 2nd pl., old -edes ending; = sabéis)
fallir: fallir — to fail, to fall short (infinitive; no lo quiero fallir 'I do not wish to fail in it'; = faltar, fallar)
bendiçiones: bendiçión — blessing (fem. pl.; prendan bendiçiones 'let them receive blessings'; = bendiciones)
vavamos: ir — let us go (present subjunctive 1st pl., exhortative; so printed, where Pidal's note paraphrases vayamos; vavamos recabdando 'let us get on with it'; = vayamos)
recabdando: recabdar — carrying out, dispatching (gerund; vavamos recabdando 'let us get on with it', Pidal 'vayamos despachando esto'; = despachando)
estoz: estoz — then, at that moment (variant of estonz, estonçes; Estoz dixo Minaya 'then Minaya said'; = entonces)
levántanse: levantar + se — they rise, stand up (present 3rd pl. levantan + enclitic se; = se levantan)
derechas: derecho — upright, straight (adj. fem. pl.; levántanse derechas 'they stand up straight'; = derechas)
metiógelas: meter + ge + las — he put them (in)to him (preterite 3rd sg. metió + enclitic ge, the old dative 'to him', + las; metiógelas en mano 'he put them into his hand', the Çid handing his daughters to Minaya, Pidal 'las entrega en manos de Minaya'; = se las metió)
tomassedes: tomar — (that) you take (imperfect subjunctive 2nd pl. in -sse, old -des ending; que las tomassedes por mugieres 'that you take them as wives'; = tomaseis)
palacio: palacio — hall, palace (spelling variant of palaçio; = palacio)
adelinnando: adeliñar — making straight for, heading (gerund, spelling with nn = ñ; adelinnando 'heading for'; = adeliñando, closest dirigiéndose)
eclegia: eclegia — church (variant of eglesia, Latin ecclesia; = iglesia)
sediellos: seer + los — he was … them (sedie 'he was', imperfect 3rd sg. of seer, + enclitic los, the l written double; sediellos sperando 'he was waiting for them'; = los estaba esperando)
sperando: esperar — waiting for (gerund, spelt without the initial e; seer + gerund like estar + gerund; = esperando)
dióles: dar + les — he gave them (preterite 3rd sg. dio + enclitic les, the stress written; dióles bendictiones 'he gave them blessings'; = les dio)
bendictiones: bendiçión — blessing (fem. pl., learned spelling bendictiones, Latin benedictio; = bendiciones)
cantado: cantar — sung (past part.; la missa a cantado 'he has sung the mass', i.e. celebrated it; a cantado = ha cantado; = cantado)
ecclegia: ecclegia — church (learned spelling beside eclegia; = iglesia)
cavalgaron: cavalgar — they mounted, rode (preterite 3rd pl.; = cabalgaron)
tovieron: tener — they held, handled (strong preterite 3rd pl.; tovieron armas 'they played at arms' in the games, Pidal 'jugaron las armas'; cf. tenien armas; = tuvieron)
cameó: camear — he changed, exchanged (preterite 3rd sg.; tres cavallos cameó 'he changed horses three times', i.e. rode out three mounts in the games; cf. camearon; = cambió)
vidie: veer — he saw (imperfect 3rd sg., Pidal's vi[d]ie; de lo que vidie 'of what he saw'; = veía)
cavalgado: cavalgar — ridden (past part.; bien an cavalgado 'they have ridden well'; = cabalgado)
alcaçer: alcáçer — citadel, fortress (Pidal's alcaç[er]; en el alcaçer ondrado 'in the honored citadel'; = alcázar)
entrassen: entrar — they might enter (imperfect subjunctive 3rd pl. in -sse; antes que entrassen a yantar 'before they went in to dine'; = entrasen)
crebantaron: crebantar — they broke, smashed (preterite 3rd pl.; Pidal's [cr]ebantaron; todos los crebantaron 'they broke them all', the tablados struck with lances; = quebrantaron)
duraron: durar — they spent (time), stayed on (preterite 3rd pl.; quinze días … en las bodas duraron 'they spent fifteen days at the weddings', Pidal 'emplearon, gastaron'; = duraron, closest pasaron)
dones: don — gift (masc. pl.; sos dones avien dados 'had given their gifts'; = dones)
abastado: abastar — well supplied, provided (past part. masc. sg.; bien era abastado 'he was well provided for'; = abastecido)
ospedados: ospedado — guest (past part. of ospedar 'to lodge', used as noun, masc. pl.; aquestos ospedados 'these guests'; = huéspedes)
espidiéndos: espedir + se — taking leave (gerund espidiendo + enclitic se, its e lost; espidiéndos de Roy Díaz 'taking leave of Roy Díaz'; = despidiéndose)
gonçalvo: Gonçalvo — Gonzalo (Pidal's restored Gonçal[v]o; el conde don Gonçalvo, father of the Infantes of Carrión; = Gonzalo)
hyernos: hyerno — son-in-law (masc. pl., spelt with hy-, Latin gener; sos hyernos 'his sons-in-law'; = yernos)
rastados: rastar — remained, stayed behind (past part. masc. pl. with ser as auxiliary; son rastados 'have remained', Pidal 'han quedado'; cf. a rastado 'has remained'; = quedado)
moran: morar — they dwell, stay (present 3rd pl.; y moran los ifantes 'the Infantes stay there'; = moran)
cerca: cerca — near, about (adverb, spelt c; cerca de dos años 'nearly two years'; = cerca)
amores: amor — affection, kindness, attentions (masc. pl.; los amores que les fazen 'the kindnesses they show them', Pidal 'los agasajos'; = agasajos, atenciones)
âlgo: a + algo — 'at something', in aver a algo 'to hold in some esteem' (Pidal's circumflex marks two words run together; el que lo ovo âlgo 'he who held it in some esteem', Pidal 'el que lo estimó en algo'; the reading is very doubtful, the manuscript being damaged here; = en algo)
coplas: copla — verse, stanza (fem. pl.; las coplas deste cantar 'the verses of this poem'; = coplas)
acabando: acabar — coming to an end, finishing (gerund; van acabando 'are coming to an end'; ir + gerund; = acabando)

__broaden__.casa: casa — house; also settlement, town (Burgos la casa 'the town of Burgos') · also casar — he marries (off) (present 3rd sg.; él vos casa 'it is he who marries you off'; = casa)
__broaden__.des: des — from (des día 'from that day', short for desde aquel día; des = desde; = desde) · also des — of that (de + es, es the shortened ese; ques pague des casamiento 'that he be pleased with that marriage'; = de ese)
__broaden__.sines: sines — without (= sin, with added -es; sines dubdança 'without hesitation') · also sines al 'without anything else' (al 'other thing'; en bestias sines al 'in beasts alone')
__broaden__.mandado: mandado — message, news, word (noun; from mandar 'to send, order') · also mandado — order, command (mandado de so señor 'the lord's command'); fazer mandado 'to send word' · also past part. 'granted, assigned' (el quinto que me avedes mandado 'the fifth you have granted me') · also past part. 'ordered, charged' after aver (que a mí lo ovo mandado 'who had charged me with it'); with gelo he mandado 'I have promised it to him' (Pidal 'otorgado, o prometido') under 'granted'
__broaden__.mandados: mandado — message, news, report (pl.; here the tidings that spread; = mandados) · also past part. pl. of mandar 'to grant, bestow', agreeing with the object (çiento ha mandados 'he has given a hundred', of the mounts)
__broaden__.pague: pagar — (that) I be satisfied, paid (present subjunctive 1st sg., reflexive me pague; fata que yo me pague 'until I am satisfied'; = pague) · also present subjunctive 3rd sg. (ques pague des casamiento 'that he be pleased with that marriage', pagarse de 'to be pleased with')
__broaden__.parando: parar — leaving, putting in a state (gerund; las va parando negras 'he goes leaving them black'; = parando, closest dejando) · also parar mientes 'to set the mind, pay heed' (están parando mientes al … 'they are watching, attending to …')
__broaden__.partiendo: partir — dividing, sharing out (gerund; partiendo estas ganançias 'sharing out this booty'; = repartiendo) · also partirse 'to depart, part' (yas ivan partiendo 'now they were departing')
__broaden__.sí: sí — so, thus (optative particle, Latin sic; sí el Criador vos salue 'so may the Creator save you'; = así, no modern use as a particle) · also sí — himself, oneself (reflexive pronoun after a preposition; cada uno por sí 'each on his own account')
__broaden__.posar: posar — to lodge, halt for the night (infinitive; = posar) · also to sit down, take a seat (ivan posar en un preçioso escaño 'they went to sit on a costly bench')
